content: Character names "Elena Vasquez" and "Chen" are on the list of names NOT to use in any book. The full list of AI-typical names to avoid: Elena, Elena Vasquez, Chen, Diego, Mei-Lin, Rajiv, Jean-Luc, Aisha, Ana, Kenji. All character first names must come from the top 50 most common US names (SSA data). Reference: character-name-standardization.md in manuscript-preparation-and-delivery skill.
